The '''Gymnasium''' was a multi-level structure in the [[Ban Belos|capital city]] of [[Rabaan]]. Covering five city blocks, it housed apartments, training centers, and an arena for members of Rabaan's warrior caste.<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>
